description: This file implements the SearchSessionFactory interface by providing a method to obtain a SearchSession that delegates event publishing. It uses Hibernate ORM and Hibernate Search integrations, annotated as a Spring component.

classes.name: SearchSessionFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implements the SearchSessionFactory to produce SearchSession instances that are integrated with Spring's event publishing.

methods.name: getSearchSession
methods.description: Returns a SearchSession that delegates event publishing to the provided ApplicationEventPublisher, wrapping the Hibernate Search session.
